reserveReview.rationale: Bureau Veritas July 2026 physical audit (PDF read directly this pass): 100% inventory of 508 gold kilo bars against the Parcel Ownership List dated 30 June 2026 at Brink's HK/SG and Malca-Amit SG, no anomalies; all bars weighed and measured. XAUm tokens and circulating supply appear nowhere in the certificate - the bar-vs-token comparison is issuer-asserted outside the artefact. Composition is a single allocated-gold category; Matrixdock's live disclosure corroborates bar count and weight. September 14 source review confirms the live BSC oracle is an XAUm price-reference feed, not a physical reserve quantity feed; the live NAV row remains an explicitly degraded price-derived proxy. The separately documented Ethereum fallback reserve feed last updated June 8, 2026 (14,209.416 with 18 decimals) and is too stale to substitute. The July report covers June 30 inventory with July 3/8/15 visits; it supplies historical custody evidence, not current token-liability reconciliation.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Physical gold is the retained reported asset category; current token-liability reconciliation, exclusive allocation and encumbrance remain unverified. Source-maintenance check 2026-10-07: Matrixdock live totals report 16716.960 fine troy ounces/16716.954084234 tokens but carry no source timestamp. Official list/download API works; newest PDF upload is September 16 while inventory basis is August 31. Tables are images and include silver rows, so grand totals mix commodities. This offline-manifest lead does not refresh the retained June 30 composition. Configured BSC proxy proves NAV price, not reserves; no exact XAUm reserve-feed sibling address was established. Do not copy XAGm feed/address or its 60-day cap. Monthly report cadence needs measured publication lag and separate inventory dates before promotion.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Bureau Veritas identifies 103 gold kilo bars at Brink's Hong Kong, 205 at Brink's Singapore and 200 at Malca-Amit Singapore against June 30 inventory. Terms revised October 21, 2025 name Matrix Mining Limited as issuer and Matrix Infinitus Hong Kong Limited as bailee and permit both allocated vault gold and unallocated gold at a financial institution. Section 9 grants the issuer a security interest under an intercompany note; section 10 restricts dealings except as permitted under that note. Current allocation weights, the note and enforceable bankruptcy safeguards remain unverified. Separate silver inventory is not XAUm gold collateral.
